description: This PHP file defines the class FormatWithNationality, which implements the ValueFormatter interface. It provides functionality to retrieve and format nationality names based on an ID, using the NationalityService.

classes.name: FormatWithNationality
classes.description: A class that implements ValueFormatter to format nationality data based on an ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the nationality by ID and returns its name if it exists.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the NationalityService instance.
